facts.business: Hittco Tools Limited is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, specifically Drill Bits, Taps, and Carbide Tools.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The domestic Drill Bits and Taps supply is going increase in the coming years. Your Company has plans to increase production of Drill Bits and Taps as well as Carbide Tools. Additionally, we are planning to expand our overseas market
guidance_or_targets.metric: Production expansion and overseas market expansion
